# Copilot instructions — callnote.app

**callnote.app** is a React + Vite + TypeScript PWA for guitar-fretboard practice: a metronome
clicks, a note name is called on the beat, and the player finds it on the neck before the next one
lands. It has a note pool, presets, routines, a practice log, a session timer, and four visual
skins.

`AGENTS.md` in the repository root is the single source of truth for how to work here — the layout,
the conventions, the one command that defines "done" (`npm run check`), and what not to touch. Read
it first and follow it; everything below is only the short version.

- **Name it correctly.** The app is `callnote.app`, lowercase, with `callnote` as the short form
  where the suffix won't fit. It is not "note trainer", "scale trainer", or any earlier name.
- **Never hard-code a brand colour.** The mark reads `--brand-*` custom properties, which alias the
  active skin's own tokens. `brand/callnote-brand-guide.md` has the rules; the SVGs beside it are
  generated by `scripts/generate-brand-assets.py`, so edit the generator rather than the output.
- **TypeScript is strict** and tests are colocated as `*.test.tsx?`. Add or adjust tests with any
  behaviour change, and keep unit tests free of real time, randomness, and live audio.
- **Commits follow Conventional Commits** — `semantic-release` derives releases from them.
